name: Zhejiang Medicine Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Medicine Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells life nutrition and pharmaceuticals products in China and internationally. The company offers synthetic vitamin E, vitamin A, natural vitamin E, ß-carotene, canthaxanthin, vancomycin hydrochloride, teicoplanin, and daptomycin. It also provides fat-soluble vitamins, quinolone antibiotics, anti-drug-resistant antibiotics, and other products, as well as animal nutrition products. In addition, the company offers injectable levofloxacin lactate, vancomycin hydrochloride injection, and injectable teicoplanin products. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.
